projection.basis: reports/1-profile.md shares (relax 15.1, advect 9.3, divergence 5.4, gradient 5.0 % of the katoomba3-standard step loop); every other phase taken as no faster

gate.bar: Gate 1, standard tier: projected whole-step gain >= 1.5x over the best TypeScript arm
gate.measured: projection 1.20x with the best form of each of the four kernels (they are 34.8 % of the step; ceiling 1.53x); assumes the rest of the step is no faster
gate.why: a kernel-only projection on the container's shared cores, against one TypeScript thread; the whole-step measurement is T6.4 / T6.6; browser threads need cross-origin isolation (plan 10.2)

notRun: arm64 execution (the android-arm64 build only proves the library compiles; it needs the phone, round 1)
the other air phases (diffuse, smagorinsky, displacements, collocate)

conditions.note: The container (4 vCPUs) is shared by up to three builders. The BenchmarkDotNet session ran 17:20 to 18:05 UTC under the heavy lock (load average 1.0 at its start, 2.2 at its end: another builder's work ran in the second half, outside the lock); TypeScript run 1 came before it, runs 2 and 3 after it, each run its own process. The thread curve is a stopwatch run in one process with DOTNET_TieredCompilation=0 (a first run under default tiering, in which all forms share one JIT profile, gave relax Vector128 slower than scalar, which BenchmarkDotNet's one-process-per-form runs and the TieredCompilation=0 run do not show: a tiering artifact, not used). Timings are indicative.

threadCurve.method: stopwatch, 400 single operations after 400 ms warm-up, median

webAssembly.what: Fs.Wasm AirExports (Mono AOT, published with dotnet publish -c Release) run under Node 22: every golden case on 4 forms, every output hash compared with the TypeScript kernels hash (the x64 tests check the same golden hashes)

k3std.runtime: .NET 11.0.0; rid browser-wasm; dynamicCode False; vector128 True

k6high.runtime: .NET 11.0.0; rid browser-wasm; dynamicCode False; vector128 True

builds.linux-x64: dotnet build Fs.Kernel -c Release -r linux-x64: ok
builds.android-arm64: dotnet build Fs.Kernel -c Release -r android-arm64: compiles only, no arm64 execution (needs the phone, round 1)
builds.browser-wasm: dotnet publish Fs.Wasm -c Release (Mono AOT, 92 s): ok, run under Node
